title: string theory lied to us and now science communication is hard
summary: Physicist Angela Collier's roughly hour-long video on how string theory was hyped to the public and what that did to science communication. She traces the history of the theory as a narrative and argues it is interesting but was oversold.
why: Recommended as an engaging critique of string theory hype and its effect on public trust in physics, and often cited alongside Peter Woit's writing.

quote.text: while the video is nearly an hour long, it feels much shorter and is well worth watching
